answer.summary: SLC10A5 encodes a sodium-dependent bile acid transporter and is not established as a tumor-growth inhibitor in lymphoma. In ATM-null DLBCL contexts, transporter/metabolic genes more often support proliferation or nutrient handling rather than suppress tumor growth, so the membership claim that SLC10A5 inhibits lymphoma tumor growth is best answered false.
